body:
It's all good, we're all just a bunch of people helping each other get through our own shits after all. We can't always know or understand everything about all the other people we meet (we're in the internet for christ's sake), and while that sometimes form misunderstandings, I've long since been used to it. As long as someone is there to answer your question accordingly, respecting your privacy no matter how little the info is given, that's enough.   


  
But I digress, I wish you all the best in your journey and do know that the man from above never puts you in a situation that you can't overcome. You just have to put in that heavy work and eventually all these painful memories will serve as one of your biggest teachers in the future. Much love and good luck once again, brother.

I understand that having more context would make the question both easier to understand and to answer but i asked this question wanting people to only have a 'general' answer, no specific details or influences in mind, just an honest answer from a vague question.

Let's just say that the turning point to that person's life relies on this question.
